(rule!
 ;; Each maroon(9) rectangular FRAME holds a few components. The key dot row
 ;; ABOVE the frame picks which one (2 = smallest, else largest); the key dot
 ;; column LEFT of it picks a transform (4 = rotate-cw, 5 = flip-lr,
 ;; 6 = rotate-180, else identity). The chosen, transformed parts line up
 ;; horizontally (vertically centered, 1-col gaps), frames in top-left order.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (crop-nonzero grid)
       (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))
                            (grid-positions grid))))
         (if (empty? cells)
             (list (list 0))
             (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
               (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
     (define (rect-frame? obj)
       ;; exactly the border of a >=3x3 bbox: every cell on the border AND
       ;; the cell count equals the perimeter
       (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
              (hh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
              (ww (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
         (and (>= hh 3) (>= ww 3)
              (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ hh ww)) 4))
              (all? (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (first bb))
                                    (= (first p) (third bb))
                                    (= (second p) (second bb))
                                    (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                    (obj-cells obj)))))
     (define frames
       (sort (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 9) (rect-frame? o)))
                     (objects g 0))
             (lambda (a b)
               (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                 (or (< (first ba) (first bb))
                     (and (= (first ba) (first bb))
                          (< (second ba) (second bb))))))))
     (define (first-key vals)
       (first (filter (lambda (v) (not (member? v (list 0 9)))) vals)))
     (define (key-above fr)
       (let ((bb (obj-bbox fr)))
         (first-key (if (>= (- (first bb) 1) 0)
                        (map (lambda (c) (at g (- (first bb) 1) c))
                             (range (second bb) (+ (fourth bb) 1)))
                        (list)))))
     (define (key-left fr)
       (let ((bb (obj-bbox fr)))
         (first-key (if (>= (- (second bb) 1) 0)
                        (map (lambda (r) (at g r (- (second bb) 1)))
                             (range (first bb) (+ (third bb) 1)))
                        (list)))))
     (define (part-of fr)
       (let* ((bb (obj-bbox fr))
              (sub (subgrid g (+ (first bb) 1) (+ (second bb) 1)
                            (- (third bb) 1) (- (fourth bb) 1)))
              (comps (sort (objects sub 0)
                           (lambda (a b) (< (obj-size a) (obj-size b)))))
              (chosen (if (= (key-above fr) 2) (first comps) (last comps)))
              (part (crop-nonzero
                     (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows sub) (cols sub) 0)
                                  (obj-cells chosen) (obj-color chosen)))))
         (cond ((= (key-left fr) 4) (rotate-cw part))
               ((= (key-left fr) 5) (flip-lr part))
               ((= (key-left fr) 6) (rotate-180 part))
               (else part))))
     (define (hstack-center pieces)
       (if (empty? pieces)
           (list (list))
           (let* ((hh (apply max (map rows pieces)))
                  (ww (+ (apply + (map cols pieces)) (- (length pieces) 1))))
             (let loop ((xs pieces) (left 0) (out (empty-grid hh ww 0)))
               (if (empty? xs)
                   out
                   (let ((piece (first xs)))
                     (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols piece) 1)
                           (paste out piece
                                  (quotient (- hh (rows piece)) 2)
                                  left))))))))
     (hstack-center (map part-of frames)))))
